AudioData.Text: Step 1: Increase Collective to turn rotor blades to help in lift
Great Job, now that collective is increased, lets move on to throttle
Step 2 : Increase Throttle to rotate the blades to increase height of helicopter. While inCreasing speed look at RPM Meter to get RPM of Helicopter Blades
Great Job, now the helicopter will attain the height, Look at the Altmeter of how its value changes when helicopter is moving upwards. Now lets move to Pedals.
Step 3 : Now Increase the right pedal to turn helicopter right
Great Job, Look at the compass in front of you, its will show helicopter direction when pedal changes.
Step4 : Increase the left pedal to turn helicopter left
Great Job, now lets make the helicopeter move to cyclic stick to control helicopter in different directions
Step 5 : Now grab the  cyclic wheel by two hands and turn it  right to move the heicopter right
Great job, now the heicopter is moving right you can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving, Look at the atitude meter when th helicopter is moving left. It tell the orientation of helicopter.
Step 6 : Now grab the cyclic wheel by two hands and turn it left to move the heicopter left
Great job, now the heicopter is moving left you can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving next we will make it move forward
Step 7 : Now grab the  cyclic stick by one hand and turn it  forward to move the heicopter forward
Great job, now the heicopter is moving forward, look at airspeed indicator to check the speed of helicopter. You can release the wheel to stop helicopter moving next we will make it move backward
Step 8 : Now grab the  cyclic stick by one hand and turn it  towards yourself to move the heicopter backward
Great Job, now we have learned to control helicopter.
